changelog:
Initial release of lanhu-to-code skill.

- Converts Lanhu design drafts, specs, screenshots, exported assets, annotations, or design links into frontend code.
- Supports HTML, CSS, React, Vue, and Tailwind implementations based on Lanhu designs.
- Guides on collecting design inputs, inspecting target codebases, extracting design system properties, and implementing screens/components.
- Emphasizes visual fidelity through inspection, visual checks, and screenshots.
- Documents assumptions and missing data; ensures semantic HTML, accessible controls, and integration with existing project conventions.
summary: Convert Lanhu (蓝湖) design drafts, specs, screenshots, exported assets, annotations, or design links into frontend code. Use when Codex is asked to implement...
